steps.title: Open the opportunity
todo: Create the Opportunity
Set the Project Type (Maintenance Type is required for Maintenance)
Attach the RFQ
Click Send to Estimation

steps.title: Price the job
todo: Fill the cost sections: Equipment scope, Team daily rates, Accommodation, Test equipment, Car and fuels, Supply, Other costs
Set the margin and check the total cost and price
Click Send to Sales, or Send for Approval when the price needs the COO / CEO
For each Supply line choose the Price Source: Supply Chain or Manual
Not going ahead? Cancel it: the RFQ goes back to Sales and the Estimation stays as history
steps.hands_to: COO / CEO when the price needs approval, otherwise Sales

steps.title: Price the supplies
todo: Open the Supply Request
Create a Supplier Quotation (one quotation can cover several requests)
Click Send Prices: the price flows back to the Estimation
steps.note: The Estimation can't go to Sales while any Supply Request is still pending.

steps.title: COO approves the price
todo: Needed only when the selling price is over the COO limit
Review the price
Approve, or Return to Estimation with a reason
steps.hands_to: CEO when over the CEO limit, otherwise Sales

steps.title: CEO approves the price
todo: Needed only when the selling price is over the CEO limit
Approve, or return it with a reason: to the COO, or to Estimation

steps.title: Quote and send the contract
todo: Click Make Quotation in the price card: the lines come with the Estimation prices
Send the Quotation to the customer
Customer changed the scope? Click Request Revision
When the customer sends the contract, click Send Contract and attach it: the Quotation goes with it
steps.note: The notes from Estimation show in the price card.

policy.receives: Selling price only, without the cost or the margin

steps.title: Review the contract
todo: Open the contract and the Quotation in Contract Rounds
Request Changes with a comment, or Accept Contract
The price must change? Click Reprice: it goes back through approval

steps.title: Win the deal
todo: Get the contract signed
Set the Opportunity to Closed Won and attach the signed contract: the Estimation comes back to Estimation for the Handover
If the customer says no, set Closed Lost: the project's life ends here
steps.note: Closed Opportunities are locked and can't be edited.

steps.title: Hand over to Planning
todo: Upload the contract and the Quotation for Planning
Click Handover to Planning
Upload the Contract (No Prices) and the Quotation (No Prices)
Click Handover to Planning

steps.title: Plan the project
todo: Build the Plan
Set the invoice dates and percentages
Set each invoice's type: Down Payment or Job Completion (can be set later)
Click Send for Approval: the Overview goes to the COO
steps.hands_to: COO, for a plan above the allowed staff days; within it, the plan is approved automatically

steps.title: First approval
todo: Needed only when the plan's staff days are above the allowed increase over the Estimation
Review the Overview: its Staff days check shows the difference
Approve, or Return to Planning with a reason
steps.receives: Overview from Planning, for a plan above the allowed staff days

steps.title: Final approval
todo: Needed after the COO, for a plan above the allowed staff days
Approve, or Return to COO with a reason

steps.title: Job completion
todo: Down Payments are ready to invoice once the Plan is approved
For a Job Completion invoice, when the work is done mark its line as completed and upload the Job Completion file
The system creates a Draft Sales Order for Finance
Undo puts that Sales Order on hold instead of deleting it

steps.title: Invoice the customer
todo: Submit the Draft Sales Order
Create the Sales Invoice from it
